name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with two or three wheels, designed for highway use and with no cab for the driver; the territory has no e-bike or moped class, so a road-going electric motorcycle is one.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels, designed for highway use, and no cab for the driver; no limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Riders need a Class 6 licence, from age 16; a Class 5 licence covers "a motorcycle known as a moped", which the law doesn't define
restrictions.citation: Driver's Licence Regulations, R.R.N.W.T. 1990, c. M-27, s. 3(2) and Schedule A

restrictions.rule: A Class 7 learner, from 15, rides accompanied by a licensed rider, who may follow on another vehicle if they've ridden at least two years as a non-novice, never between 11 p.m. and 6 a.m., and not in a speed zone of 70 km/h or more
restrictions.citation: Driver's Licence Regulations, R.R.N.W.T. 1990, c. M-27, ss. 3(3), 4 and 4.1

restrictions.rule: Registered and plated to be ridden on a highway, and covered by a motor vehicle liability policy to be ridden or parked on one
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, ss. 5, 6 and 36(2)

restrictions.rule: Every rider and passenger must wear a labelled helmet meeting CSA, ECE, BSI, DOT, ANSI or Snell standards
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 243; Motorcycle Helmet Regulations, R-052-2011, s. 1

restrictions.rule: A passenger rides only on a seat built for one or in a sidecar, and must reach the foot-pegs or floorboards; nobody stands while riding
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 242

restrictions.rule: One built for cross-country travel off the highway is an all-terrain vehicle instead
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 1; All-terrain Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. A-3, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Only an amendment to the Motor Vehicles Act could change its definitions of vehicle, motor vehicle, motorcycle, bicycle and all-terrain vehicle, though regulations could set which motorized two-wheelers need a motorcycle or Class 5 licence, the Minister of Infrastructure told the Legislative Assembly in June 2024
